method: curve account read at commitment confirmed (context_slot), signature head unchanged before and after the read, then the first confirmed tx touching the curve afterwards; accepted only when it was the lone new tx and its logs held a Pump Sell TradeEvent for this mint with slot > context_slot
notes: rows[] are SOL-quoted curves ONLY (account bytes 83..114 all zero AND event quote_mint = default key); amounts are lamports in sol_amount / virtual_sol_reserves / real_sol_reserves
quote_token_rows[] are curves quoted in another token; their legacy sol_* fields read 0 and amounts are in quote atoms: NOT lamports, kept only for the layout and formula
every kept row reproduces its own event exactly from the pre-state bytes: gross, post virtual/real reserves, protocol and creator fee (ceil)
protocol fee bps 0 appears only on ix_name multi_hop_swap router sells
2 pair(s) dropped: reserves did not reproduce, so another trade landed between the account read and the sell
